mapper.select: select max(if(stat.stat_type = '0401', stat.stat_num , 0)) playStatNum, max(if(stat.stat_type = '0402' ,stat.stat_num , 0)) subscribeStatNum , max(if(stat.stat_type = '0403' ,stat.stat_num , 0)) buyStatNum , max(if(stat.stat_type = '0404' ,stat.stat_num , 0)) commentStatNum from album_stat stat where stat.album_id = #{id}
